sources.title: xThr45hx/Tensor-G4-NPU-Compiler-Toolchains · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google Tensor G4 NPU — DGC0 Compiler Toolchains Two independently-developed reverse-engineering toolchains for producing DGC0 (EdgeTPU bytecode) for the Google Tensor G4 NPU (the darwinn EdgeTPU in Pixel 9-series phones). Both were built to answer one question: how do you compile a model to run on the G4 NPU when the compiler is gated/undocumented?
